scientific_integrity: Analytic proof of one exact critical-level classification with a finite algebraic reproducibility check; prior integral and negative-energy results are attributed.
scientific_limitations: Only the conserved surface H=0, integers q>=2, in original physical time. No claim for nonzero energy or q=1. The 2024 periodic-orbit article was accessible only by abstract; equivalent results in uninspected older literature remain possible. Independent audit has not been performed.
title: Complete critical-energy dynamics for the generalized Chazy flow
